# Skill: run-bruno-api-tests

**When to use:** Run the generated Bruno API collection against a configurable Conduit backend host.

## Scope
- `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-bruno.sh`
- `realworld/specs/api/bruno`

## Prerequisites
- Bun runtime for @usebruno/cli
- Backend reachable at HOST

## Steps
1. Set HOST and optional BRUNO_SANDBOX (default safe).
2. Run realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-bruno.sh; default runs all bruno subfolders except environments.
3. Pass optional folder arguments to limit the collection run.
4. CLI pattern: bun x @usebruno/cli run <folder> --env local --env-var host=$HOST --sandbox $BRUNO_SANDBOX.

## Existing example
- `realworld/specs/api/bruno/bruno.json names collection RealWorld API; CI bruno-check.yml uses Bun.`
